Brand.name: Lebanon Ecom OS
Brand.tagline: Founder OS for importing and selling one SKU in Lebanon

Home.lead: Lebanon Ecom OS helps founders import a small product from China, sell it through their own Shopify store in Lebanon, and follow a clear guided path from first sample to first sales.
Home.headline: One product. One store. One clear path.
Home.sub: Start in minutes — in English or Arabic — and move into discovery with a dashboard that shows exactly what to do next.

Onboarding.title: Founder onboarding
Onboarding.subtitle: Tell us about your budget, capacity, and Lebanon sellability so we can guide one SKU.
Onboarding.editSubtitle: Update your saved budget, capacity, industries, and Lebanon details. Changes save to your account.
Onboarding.categoryLikesHint: Select one or more. Soft preference for product discovery.
Onboarding.lebanonSellability: I understand products must be sellable in Lebanon (regulations, demand, and logistics).
Onboarding.codNoticeBody: COD is common in Lebanon and carries collection risk, refusal rates, and courier fees. Plan margins and cash flow accordingly.
Onboarding.sampleClearance: I am ready to handle sample clearance with a partner when needed.
Onboarding.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Check the form and try again.

Dashboard.title: Dashboard

Dashboard.shortlistEmpty: Empty shortlist slot — discovery agent not started yet.
Dashboard.coachingSlot: Coaching card slot — guidance will appear here.

Discovery.title: Product discovery
Discovery.intro: An ability-matched shortlist for your budget, experience, and capacity. Confirm real demand, then accept one product to begin the supplier path.
Discovery.startHint: We'll match 5 products to your profile. You can reveal more, up to 25 per session.
Discovery.blockedOversized: Oversized — can't ship economically for Lebanon.
Discovery.blockedMargin: Margins below target (need ≥ 70% before ads and ≥ 35% after ads).
Discovery.demandNeeded: Confirm a real demand signal before accepting.
Discovery.demandEmpty: Add at least one: URL, note, or screenshot.
Discovery.tier1Body: Already sold on {markets}. Customize with your supplier to differentiate, or drop it.
Discovery.riskAck: I have read and accept this risk.
Discovery.acceptOkayHint: Okay product — acknowledge the risk read to accept.
Discovery.acceptedBody: {name} is now your active SKU. Next: the supplier & sample path.
